summary: New run folders are named from the UTC clock; runs.Load orders folders (per layout) by the earliest iteration/session timestamp, falling back to path, so every consumer sees record order. Existing folders are not renamed.
verified: vloop task gate T10 equivalent (sh .vloop/state/gates/T10/gate.sh) printed gate T10: ok; go test ./internal/cli ./internal/runs passes with VLOOP_* env cleared.
notes: All consumers go through runs.Load, so the ordering lives in sortFolders there. Inside a loop session, internal/cli task_gate tests fail only because VLOOP_* env is set; they pass under env -i.
